type.description: The variant type of context menu to display. - 'regular': Single-select navigation menu. - 'checkboxes': Multi-select with checkboxes. - 'nested-checkboxes': Multi-select with nested/hierarchical checkboxes. -...

hasTitleBar.description: Whether to show a title bar with close button at the top of the menu. If true, displays the title property and a close icon button.

title.description: The title of the title bar, drawn while `hasTitleBar` is true.

itemsPerColumn.description: Number of items per column in multi-column layouts. Used in multi and multi-with-subtitles variants to control column splitting. Available when type in [Multi, MultiWithSubtitles].

multiSelect.description: Whether several options can be selected. Empty leaves the choice to `type` (the checkbox and multi types select several).

selectPerGroup.description: Whether one option is selected for each group or column. Empty leaves the choice to `type` (the flyout type selects one for each group).

options.description: The options of the menu, one object each: `value` (unique; the events report it), `label`, `level` (the depth of the option, from 0) and `children` (objects of the same form, for the flyout and nested types). An option's icon (a template function in the element) is not carried.

columnGroups.description: The column groups of the multi column types, one object each: `title`, `columns` (the least number of columns the group draws) and `options` (objects with `value` and `label`).

selectedValues.description: A list of values as plain text, in order.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
